decisions.reason: a bit and a little are interchangeable for 좀; no real gain.
용케 is the against-the-odds “somehow”; SOL’s “did manage” drops that.
모르긴 몰라도 is a hedge, not “I didn’t know the details.”
“Telling remark” matches 의미심장하게 들리는 한마디; BASE adds “choice of words.”
Restores 마른침; BASE’s plain “swallowed” omits the dry swallow.
Weary 그랬군 / 그렇게 됐어 lands better as “I see / it came to that” than stiff “So he is.”
“Absently” is the natural collocation for 무심코 reaching for a glass.
Keeps 한발 빨리 as “a step ahead”; BASE invents “could reach him.”
More natural English for 누군가에게 그런 말을 하는 것이 처음, with “to anyone” intact.
SOL drops 엄청 and adds unsupported “just as/clearly.”
SOL captures 천하에 and 호쾌한 but weakens 한참 어린; this keeps both.
decisions.replacement: “For the world-renowned Fire King, Great Hero Jeok Cheongang, to personally apologize to a much younger junior like me! I can only bow before your magnanimous spirit and humility.”

decisions.reason: Fronted “whether to hit me or not” matches the Korean and avoids the garden path in BASE.
“Once and for all today” matches 오늘 하루를 마지막으로; BASE’s “after today” is off.
Cleaner rhythm for turning with the ant-small voice, then 곧장 멈칫.
Compact gnomic present matches 영원한 강자도, 약자도 없다; BASE is wordy translationese.
Keeps 결국 as “ultimately” and natural present; BASE drops 결국 and is stiff.
BASE mistranslates 착각 as “forgot”; SOL drops 종종.
decisions.replacement: Yet there are those who often mistake that fact. Drunk on their own strength—or on blood—they take the wrong path.

decisions.reason: Tighter equivalent of 그렇다고 믿었다 without BASE’s extra “what he had been.”
BASE’s “closest distance” is calqued; SOL’s “up close” drops 가장.
decisions.replacement: Jeok Cheongang had watched it closer than anyone, yet he hadn’t known.

decisions.reason: Comma matches 아, as one realization beat rather than a two-sentence pause.
